verdict.line: You lose if you trade into 4-5 stacks of her passive; you win every extended fight once Bladesurge is down and your armor items are online.

brief.thesis: Irelia's damage is gated behind Ionian Fervor stacks and whether Bladesurge is up, while Malphite's E (Ground Slam) scales off armor and directly guts the attack speed she needs to stack that passive. This is a 55.3% Malphite matchup over 2389 games because Malphite's kit counters her exact win condition, not because Irelia is weak.

theirWindow.what: Disengage and reset to wave. At max stacks she gains bonus on-hit damage and can burst your HP before your Brutal Strikes window pays off, matching the live tip to never fight her there.

yourWindow.when: Her Q (Bladesurge) just went on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Step in and trade freely with Q (Seismic Shard) into E (Ground Slam). Without the dash she has no gap-closer or escape, and your Q outranges her remaining threats at 625 to her 400-825 kit.

start.why: 57.2% win rate over 739 games. The health regen offsets Irelia's auto-reliant poke and Bladesurge heal better than Doran's Ring does in a matchup where she's constantly in range to auto you.

boots.why: 55.1% win rate, 88.7% pick rate. Flat reduction on every auto she lands directly undercuts the on-hit damage her passive stacks toward.

core.why: Grievous Wounds cuts the sustain from her Q heal immediately, before she can out-trade you on the wave.
Passive burn adds free wave and trade damage while you stack armor, pressuring her off CS.
Punishes her auto-attack-reliant passive hardest of any item in the 60.6% win rate core path over 180 games.
The attack speed slow directly fights the attack speed she's trying to stack, on top of completing the highest-win-rate full build.

situational.when: the enemy team stacks magic damage alongside Irelia
the game runs long and you need more teamfight durability than pure armor
their team has heavy CC or magic damage layered behind Irelia

runes.keystoneWhy: 58.6% win rate, 33.6% pick rate. The heal and max-HP scaling win extended trades against her sustain-heavy Q. Master-tier Malphite players instead run Arcane Comet across 16,740 games — better for players who want to punish her approach with upfront poke rather than win the slow grind.

summoners.why: 55.1% win rate at 74.6% pick rate, the standard choice since this matchup rewards scaling into side-lane TP plays rather than all-in kill pressure. Flash+Ignite (55.5%) is a viable alternative if you expect to win early trades outright.

playing.title: Punish missed Q resets
playing.detail: Bladesurge refreshes only if the target is Marked or dies. If her dash whiffs or just kills a minion without a reset, her gap-closer is down for its full cooldown (10-6s by rank) — that's your window to step up.

playing.title: Lead trades with E, not Q
playing.detail: Ground Slam's attack speed reduction directly denies the stacks her passive needs. Firing it the moment she closes range blunts her entire combo before it starts.

playing.title: Never fight at max stacks
playing.detail: Per the live tip, 5 stacks of Ionian Fervor grants her bonus on-hit damage. Back off and reset to wave instead of trading into it.

playing.title: Her W doesn't blunt your damage
playing.detail: Defiant Dance only reduces physical damage taken while charging. Your Q, E, and R are all magic damage, so her charge timing gives her no defensive window against you specifically.

playing.title: Hold Q for her retreat
playing.detail: Seismic Shard steals movement speed on hit. Save it to punish her walking away post-trade rather than opening with it.

playing.title: All-in with R after level 6
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force's 1000 range catches her mid-combo since her only disengage is the Q dash, which she usually commits forward with, not backward.

playing.title: Rush Bramble Vest on low health
playing.detail: Grievous Wounds cuts her Q sustain and passive attack-speed poke at the same time, which is why the armor-first core outperforms generic tank paths here.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build paths, runes, and summoner spells above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Do not fight Irelia when she has 5 stacks of (P). If she closes in first, use [E] to reduce her attack speed. She becomes an easier opponent as the game progresses.
